values.zh-CN: 跨实体所有权与精确成员关系

content.markdown:
Every Entry and Macro envelope owner MUST resolve to a Package manifest. Every configured active Macro Package MUST also resolve.

For current entity-storage versions, each Package `entry_ids` MUST equal exactly the sorted set of all Entry IDs whose envelope owner is that Package. Missing members, extra members, wrong-owner members, duplicates, or order drift are fatal. Point reads additionally require the requested Entry to be indexed by its owner manifest.
